artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan landing P8, two forced helpers and the eleven unported Pthm:11--Pthm:22 interaction principles in a new FormalSystem/Theorems/Interaction.lean, with both aggregators wired in Phase 1 and all sixteen signatures plan-time-verified.

memory_candidates.content: In the BimodalLogic (ProofChecker) Lean tree, adding a NEW module under FormalSystem/ requires TWO aggregator import lines, not one: the subtree aggregator (e.g. FormalSystem/Theorems.lean) and the ROOT FormalSystem.lean, which check C33 of scripts/check-module-invariants.sh requires to be byte-for-byte `lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem` output (one sorted import per .lean file). Consequence for plan decomposition: the aggregator wiring must land in the FIRST phase that creates the module, never deferred to a terminal 'isolate the shared touch' phase -- deferring leaves every intermediate commit C33-red and unclosable. A second, unavoidable consequence: the new file immediately staleness-breaks the generated inventory blocks (FormalSystem/Theorems/README.md, FormalSystem/README.md, README.md) and typst/generated/status.typ (whole-tree line counts), so check-module-invariants.sh's INV group is red by construction from module creation until a terminal regeneration phase; intermediate phases must assert their NAMED checks pass rather than whole-script exit 0, which is unsatisfiable mid-sequence.
